column2: epigene_results_summary %>% dplyr::select(gene, D, T1, T2, Description) %>%
str_detect(Description, regex("WD40 repeats", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "WD40 repeats",
str_detect(Description, regex("PHD", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PHD finger protein",
str_detect(Description, regex("mRNA", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~  "mRNA cap 0 methyltransferase",
str_detect(Description, regex("RsmB NOP family", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~  "RsmB NOP family",
str_detect(Description, regex("gTMT family", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~  "gTMT family",
str_detect(Description, regex("reader", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "DNA methylation reader",
